chapter_title: Improving a Resource with AI Agents
learning_objective: The learner will identify which of the six workflow steps matches each of six descriptions, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
specification:
Type: infographic **sim-id:** improvement-workflow-poster
**Library:** html
**Status:** Specified
**Bloom Level:** Remember
**Bloom Verb:** identify
**Learning Objective:** The learner will identify which of the six workflow steps matches each of six descriptions, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt. **Prerequisites:** Derivative Work, Improvement Plan, Lowest Metric First, Human Review of Changes, Change Log Entry, Re-Scoring (all defined in this chapter above this block). **Evidence of Mastery:** In quiz mode the learner clicks the poster zone that matches each description. A click is correct when the zone's id equals the Correct zone column in Content. Mastery is at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt. Hovering a zone in explore mode is exploration, not evidence. **Misconceptions:** (1) Re-scoring covers only the metrics you changed. (2) Logging can wait until the end. (3) The license check is needed only when publishing. **Instructional Rationale:** Remembering the order and purpose of the six steps is a Remember-level task, and a poster with six panels in order lets the learner hold the whole workflow at once. The quiz asks for the step by its purpose. **Content:** The poster is a flat illustration of six equal panels in two rows of three, read left to right and top to bottom. Each panel shows one simple pictogram and a step number, and the printed text is limited to the six step numbers. The first panel shows an open padlock above a document. The second shows a row of bars with the shortest bar highlighted. The third shows a hand holding a wand over a document. The fourth shows a magnifying glass over two stacked pages with a check mark. The fifth shows a notebook with ruled lines. The sixth shows two sets of ten bars side by side. All other words come from the explore and quiz data. The six zones: | Zone id | Label | Summary | Facts shown on hover or click | |---|---|---|---| | step-1-license | 1. Check the license | Confirm you may make and share a derivative work. | Read the license first. NoDerivatives and a missing license stop the work. Note the credit and the statement of changes that the license requires. | | step-2-plan | 2. Plan lowest first | Write the fixes in order, with hours and projected gain. | Start with the lowest metric. Set a budget. Write the projected gain so you can compare it later. | | step-3-fix | 3. Fix with an agent | Let the agent draft each fix. | Give the agent the context. Expect the known mistake for each fix. Keep the original meaning. | | step-4-review | 4. Review every change | A person checks each change against the source. | Use a difference view. Accept, correct, or reject each change. Check high-risk changes in full. | | step-5-log | 5. Log each change | Record when, where, what, why, who, reviewer, and decision. | One entry per change. The log supports the statement of changes and the re-score. | | step-6-rescore | 6. Re-score all ten | Score the improved version the same way as the first. | Use the same prompt. Verify the changed scores. Report the gain and any metric that fell. | The six quiz questions, in this order: | # | Question | Correct zone | Why (shown as feedback) | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | Which step stops the work if the original is NoDerivatives? | step-1-license | The license decides whether a changed version may be shared. | | 2 | Which step sets a budget and projected gain? | step-2-plan | The plan holds the hours and the forecast. | | 3 | Which step catches a figure the agent invented? | step-4-review | A person checks each change against the source. | | 4 | Which step finds that a new simulation lowered portability? | step-6-rescore | Only scoring all ten metrics shows a side effect. | | 5 | Which step records who reviewed each change? | step-5-log | The log holds the reviewer and the decision. | | 6 | Which step drafts alt text and metadata? | step-3-fix | The agent drafts the fixes. | **Provenance:** The six steps follow the chapter sections "Improvement Plan", "Derivative Work", "The Fix Toolkit", "Human Review of Changes", "Change Log Entry", and "Re-Scoring". The illustration is synthetic, and it carries no statistics. **Rules:** Each question has exactly one correct zone. Zones are distinct regions of the poster, so a click belongs to at most one zone. Because the poster prints only step numbers, the sim shows the zone labels on hover. **Learner Activity:** 1. In explore mode the learner hovers or clicks a panel and reads its summary and facts. 2. In quiz mode the sim shows question 1 above the poster. 3. The learner clicks the panel they think matches. 4. The sim shows the Why text and moves to the next question, until question 6 is done. **Feedback:** 6 questions in the fixed order, one attempt each. Correct: "Correct: [label]. [Why]". Incorrect: "Not quite. The answer is [label]. [Why]". The summary shows "[n] of 6 correct on the first attempt". At 5 or more it adds "You know the improvement workflow." Below 5 it lists the Why text of each missed question. **Starting State:** The poster with no zone selected, explore mode active, and the prompt "Hover a panel to learn about the step." **Chapter Anchors:** The chapter's eight deliverables of the improvement challenge include these six steps. The poster leaves out the baseline and the report, which bracket the workflow.
